heading.en: Which collections count as a set?

hook.en: The rivers of India is a set. The good movies of this year is not. Today we find out why.

title.en: A set is a well-defined collection

body.en: A set is a well-defined collection of objects: for any object we can say clearly whether it belongs to the set or not. The objects are its elements. We write $a \in A$ if $a$ belongs to $A$ and $b \notin A$ if it does not. Standard sets: $N$ (natural numbers), $Z$ (integers), $Q$ (rationals), $R$ (reals).
body.kn: ಗಣ ಎಂದರೆ ಸ್ಪಷ್ಟವಾಗಿ ನಿರೂಪಿತವಾದ ವಸ್ತುಗಳ ಸಂಗ್ರಹ. ಯಾವುದೇ ವಸ್ತು ಗಣಕ್ಕೆ ಸೇರುತ್ತದೆಯೇ ಇಲ್ಲವೇ ಎಂದು ಖಚಿತವಾಗಿ ಹೇಳಲು ಸಾಧ್ಯವಾಗಬೇಕು.

points.en: Well defined: membership is not a matter of opinion
∈ means "belongs to", ∉ means "does not belong to"

narration.en: A set is a well-defined collection: for any object we must be able to say yes or no, it belongs or it does not. We write "a belongs to A" with the symbol epsilon.

narration.en: A set needs a clear yes-or-no test for membership.

text.en: The vowels of the English alphabet
The planets of our solar system
The five most talented writers of India
The tall students of your class
The most beautiful cities of Karnataka
The most dangerous animals in the world

explanation.en: A collection is a set only when anyone can decide, without opinion, whether an object belongs to it. Words like talented, tall, beautiful or dangerous depend on opinion.
explanation.kn: ಯಾವುದೇ ವಸ್ತು ಸಂಗ್ರಹಕ್ಕೆ ಸೇರಿದೆಯೇ ಎಂದು ಅಭಿಪ್ರಾಯವಿಲ್ಲದೆ ನಿರ್ಧರಿಸಬಹುದಾದಾಗ ಮಾತ್ರ ಅದು ಗಣ. ಪ್ರತಿಭಾವಂತ, ಎತ್ತರ, ಸುಂದರ ಮುಂತಾದ ಪದಗಳು ಅಭಿಪ್ರಾಯವನ್ನು ಅವಲಂಬಿಸಿವೆ.

body.en: In roster (tabular) form we list the elements inside braces, separated by commas, each written once: the vowels are $\{a, e, i, o, u\}$. In set-builder form we state the property shared by all elements: $\{x : x \text{ is a vowel}\}$. The order of listing does not matter.
body.kn: ಪಟ್ಟಿ ರೂಪದಲ್ಲಿ ಅಂಶಗಳನ್ನು ಕಂಸಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಒಮ್ಮೆ ಮಾತ್ರ ಬರೆಯುತ್ತೇವೆ. ಗಣ ನಿರ್ಮಾಣ ರೂಪದಲ್ಲಿ ಅಂಶಗಳ ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಗುಣವನ್ನು ಹೇಳುತ್ತೇವೆ.
